Universal_Algo_Trading_Standard.description: Universal Standard for Algorithmic Trading Strategies (USTATS) - Collated & Enhanced for Automated Execution

metadata.title: Universal 151 Trading Strategies Engine
sources: 151 Trading Strategies by Zura Kakushadze and Juan Andrés Serur

audience.humans: Quant researchers, portfolio managers, and algorithmic traders
audience.machines: Automated trading engines, execution management systems (EMS), and order management systems (OMS)

latency_profiles.MFT: Medium-Frequency (Seconds to Minutes) - Algorithmic slicing, TWAP/VWAP
latency_profiles.LFT: Low-Frequency (Hours to Days) - Daily/Monthly rebalancing, Portfolio Optimization

data_feeds.Alternative: Sentiment, Satellite, Order Flow, COT Reports

arbitrage_metrics.put_call_parity: C - P = S - K * exp(-r * T)

strategies.name: Covered Call
strategies.description: Long Stock + Short OTM Call. Generates income while capping upside.
strategies.pseudocode: IF holds_stock AND outlook == 'neutral': SELL OTM_CALL(K)

strategies.name: Price-Momentum
strategies.description: Long Top Decile, Short Bottom Decile based on 12m cumulative return (skip 1m).
strategies.pseudocode: RANK universe BY R_cum DESC; BUY top_10%; SHORT bottom_10%

strategies.name: Pairs Trading
strategies.description: Long cheap, Short rich based on Z-score of cointegrated spread.
strategies.pseudocode: IF Z > 2.0: SHORT A, BUY B. EXIT AT Z == 0

strategies.name: Barbell
strategies.description: 50% Short-Term Bonds + 50% Long-Term Bonds. Matches duration of bullet, higher convexity.
strategies.pseudocode: SOLVE w1, w2 FOR Target_Duration; BUY w1, w2

strategies.name: Cash-and-Carry Arbitrage
strategies.description: Long Spot Basket + Short Futures when Basis > Costs.
strategies.math: F_fair = (S - D) * exp(r*T); IF F_actual > F_fair + costs
strategies.pseudocode: IF F > F_fair: SHORT futures, BUY spot basket

strategies.name: VIX Futures Basis Trading
strategies.description: Short VIX Futures in Contango to capture roll yield.
strategies.pseudocode: IF B_VIX > 0: SHORT UX1. Hedge with mini-SPX

strategies.name: Carry Trade
strategies.description: Short Low-Yield Currency + Long High-Yield Currency.
strategies.pseudocode: RANK by forward_discount; BUY top_quantile, SELL bottom_quantile

strategies.name: Roll Yields
strategies.description: Long Backwardated Commodities, Short Contango Commodities.
strategies.pseudocode: RANK commodities BY phi; BUY highest, SELL lowest

strategies.name: Convertible Arbitrage
strategies.description: Long Convertible Bond + Short (Delta * Stock).
strategies.pseudocode: BUY CB; SHORT h * Stock; REBALANCE Delta daily

strategies.name: Municipal Bond Tax Arbitrage
strategies.description: Short Cash (Loan) + Long Tax-Exempt Muni Bond.
strategies.pseudocode: IF r_muni > r_loan * (1 - tau): BORROW cash, BUY muni

strategies.name: Covered Put
strategies.description: Short Stock + Short Put. Neutral to bearish income.
strategies.pseudocode: IF short_stock: SELL OTM_PUT(K)

strategies.name: Protective Put
strategies.description: Long Stock + Long Put. Portfolio insurance.
strategies.pseudocode: IF holds_stock AND fear_of_crash: BUY OTM_PUT(K)

strategies.name: Protective Call
strategies.description: Short Stock + Long Call. Hedge against short squeeze.
strategies.pseudocode: IF short_stock: BUY OTM_CALL(K)

strategies.name: Bull Call Spread
strategies.description: Long Call(K1) + Short Call(K2), K1 < K2. Net debit.
strategies.math: Max_Profit = K2 - K1 - D; Break_Even = K1 + D
strategies.pseudocode: IF moderately_bullish: BUY_CALL(K1), SELL_CALL(K2)

strategies.name: Bull Put Spread
strategies.description: Long Put(K1) + Short Put(K2), K1 < K2. Net credit.
strategies.pseudocode: IF neutral_to_bullish: SELL_PUT(K2), BUY_PUT(K1)

strategies.name: Bear Call Spread
strategies.description: Long Call(K1) + Short Call(K2), K1 > K2. Net credit.
strategies.pseudocode: IF neutral_to_bearish: SELL_CALL(K2), BUY_CALL(K1)

strategies.name: Bear Put Spread
strategies.description: Long Put(K1) + Short Put(K2), K1 > K2. Net debit.
strategies.math: Max_Profit = K1 - K2 - D; Break_Even = K1 - D
strategies.pseudocode: IF moderately_bearish: BUY_PUT(K1), SELL_PUT(K2)

strategies.name: Long Synthetic Forward
strategies.description: Long Call(K) + Short Put(K), K = S_0. Replicates long stock.
strategies.pseudocode: IF bullish AND capital_efficiency_needed: BUY_CALL(K), SELL_PUT(K)

strategies.name: Short Synthetic Forward
strategies.description: Long Put(K) + Short Call(K), K = S_0. Replicates short stock.
strategies.pseudocode: IF bearish AND hard_to_borrow: BUY_PUT(K), SELL_CALL(K)

strategies.name: Long Combo
strategies.description: Long OTM Call(K1) + Short OTM Put(K2), K1 > K2. Zero-cost bullish.
strategies.pseudocode: IF strongly_bullish: BUY_CALL(K1), SELL_PUT(K2)

strategies.name: Bull Call Ladder
strategies.description: Long Call(K1) + Short Call(K2) + Short Call(K3), K1 < K2 < K3.
strategies.math: Max_Profit at S_T = K2; Unlimited upside risk past K3
strategies.pseudocode: IF moderately_bullish: BUY(K1), SELL(K2), SELL(K3)

strategies.name: Bull Put Ladder
strategies.description: Short Put(K1) + Long Put(K2) + Long Put(K3), K1 > K2 > K3.
strategies.math: Max_Profit at S_T = K2; Loss zone below K3
strategies.pseudocode: IF mildly_bearish: SELL(K1), BUY(K2), BUY(K3)

strategies.name: Bear Call Ladder
strategies.description: Short Call(K1) + Long Call(K2) + Long Call(K3), K1 < K2 < K3.
strategies.math: Max_Loss at S_T = K2; Unlimited profit past K3
strategies.pseudocode: IF breakout_bullish: SELL(K1), BUY(K2), BUY(K3)

strategies.name: Bear Put Ladder
strategies.description: Long Put(K1) + Short Put(K2) + Short Put(K3), K1 > K2 > K3.
strategies.math: Max_Profit at S_T = K2; Unlimited downside risk past K3
strategies.pseudocode: IF mildly_bearish: BUY(K1), SELL(K2), SELL(K3)

strategies.name: Calendar Call Spread
strategies.description: Long Call(K, T2) + Short Call(K, T1), T2 > T1. Profits from theta decay.
strategies.pseudocode: IF neutral AND IV_contango: BUY_CALL(K,T2), SELL_CALL(K,T1)

strategies.name: Calendar Put Spread
strategies.description: Long Put(K, T2) + Short Put(K, T1), T2 > T1.
strategies.pseudocode: IF neutral: BUY_PUT(K,T2), SELL_PUT(K,T1)

strategies.name: Diagonal Call Spread
strategies.description: Long Call(K1, T2) + Short Call(K2, T1), K1 < K2, T2 > T1.
strategies.pseudocode: IF moderately_bullish: BUY_CALL(K1,T2), SELL_CALL(K2,T1)

strategies.name: Diagonal Put Spread
strategies.description: Long Put(K1, T2) + Short Put(K2, T1), K1 > K2, T2 > T1.
strategies.pseudocode: IF moderately_bearish: BUY_PUT(K1,T2), SELL_PUT(K2,T1)

strategies.name: Long Straddle
strategies.description: Long Call(K) + Long Put(K), K = S_0. Long Gamma/Vega, Short Theta.
strategies.pseudocode: IF expected_move > D_total: BUY_CALL(K), BUY_PUT(K)

strategies.name: Long Strangle
strategies.description: Long Put(K1) + Long Call(K2), K1 < S_0 < K2. Cheaper than straddle.
strategies.pseudocode: IF expected_move > (K2-K1)/2 + D: BUY_PUT(K1), BUY_CALL(K2)

strategies.name: Short Straddle
strategies.description: Short Call(K) + Short Put(K). Short Gamma/Vega, Long Theta.
strategies.pseudocode: IF pin_risk_neutral AND IV_rank > 80: SELL_CALL(K), SELL_PUT(K)

strategies.name: Short Strangle
strategies.description: Short Call(K1) + Short Put(K2), K1 > K2. Wider buffer than straddle.
strategies.math: Max_Profit = C_net if K2 <= S_T <= K1
strategies.pseudocode: IF range_bound: SELL_OTM_CALL(K1), SELL_OTM_PUT(K2)

strategies.name: Short Guts
strategies.description: Short ITM Call(K1) + Short ITM Put(K2). Max premium, high assignment risk.
strategies.pseudocode: IF max_premium_needed: SELL_ITM_CALL(K1), SELL_ITM_PUT(K2)

strategies.name: Long Call Synthetic Straddle
strategies.description: Short Stock + 2 * Long Call(K). Bypasses put skew/borrow issues.
strategies.pseudocode: IF put_skew_too_high: SHORT_STOCK, BUY_2x_CALL(K)

strategies.name: Long Put Synthetic Straddle
strategies.description: Long Stock + 2 * Long Put(K). Bypasses call skew.
strategies.pseudocode: IF call_skew_too_high: BUY_STOCK, BUY_2x_PUT(K)

strategies.name: Short Call Synthetic Straddle
strategies.description: Long Stock + 2 * Short Call(K).
strategies.pseudocode: IF put_skew_too_high_to_sell: BUY_STOCK, SELL_2x_CALL(K)

strategies.name: Short Put Synthetic Straddle
strategies.description: Short Stock + 2 * Short Put(K).
strategies.pseudocode: IF call_skew_too_high_to_sell: SHORT_STOCK, SELL_2x_PUT(K)

strategies.name: Covered Short Straddle
strategies.description: Long Stock + Short Call(K) + Short Put(K).
strategies.pseudocode: IF holds_stock AND bullish_neutral: SELL_CALL(K), SELL_PUT(K)

strategies.name: Covered Short Strangle
strategies.description: Long Stock + Short Call(K1) + Short Put(K2), K1 > K2.
strategies.pseudocode: IF range_bound_bullish: SELL_OTM_CALL(K1), SELL_OTM_PUT(K2)

strategies.name: Strap
strategies.description: 2 * Long Call(K) + Long Put(K). Bullish straddle.
strategies.math: Payoff = 2 * max(S_T - K, 0) + max(K - S_T, 0) - D
strategies.pseudocode: IF bullish_volatility: BUY_2x_CALL(K), BUY_PUT(K)

strategies.name: Strip
strategies.description: Long Call(K) + 2 * Long Put(K). Bearish straddle.
strategies.math: Payoff = max(S_T - K, 0) + 2 * max(K - S_T, 0) - D
strategies.pseudocode: IF bearish_volatility: BUY_CALL(K), BUY_2x_PUT(K)

strategies.name: Call Ratio Backspread
strategies.description: Short N_S Call(K1) + Long N_L Call(K2), N_L > N_S. E.g., 1x2.
strategies.math: Max_Profit = Unlimited upside; Max_Loss at K2
strategies.pseudocode: IF strongly_bullish_breakout: SELL_CALL(K1), BUY_2x_CALL(K2)

strategies.name: Put Ratio Backspread
strategies.description: Short N_S Put(K1) + Long N_L Put(K2), N_L > N_S.
strategies.math: Max_Profit = Large downside; Max_Loss at K2
strategies.pseudocode: IF strongly_bearish_crash: SELL_PUT(K1), BUY_2x_PUT(K2)

strategies.name: Long Call Butterfly
strategies.description: Long Call(K1) - 2*Call(K2) + Long Call(K3). Equidistant strikes.
strategies.math: Max_Profit = κ - D at S_T = K2
strategies.pseudocode: IF neutral_low_vol: BUY(K1), SELL_2x(K2), BUY(K3)

strategies.name: Long Put Butterfly
strategies.description: Long Put(K1) - 2*Put(K2) + Long Put(K3).
strategies.math: Max_Profit = κ - D at S_T = K2
strategies.pseudocode: IF neutral_low_vol: BUY(K1), SELL_2x(K2), BUY(K3)

strategies.name: Short Call Butterfly
strategies.description: Short Call(K1) + 2*Call(K2) - Short Call(K3).
strategies.math: Max_Profit = C if S_T <= K1 or S_T >= K3
strategies.pseudocode: IF high_volatility: SELL(K1), BUY_2x(K2), SELL(K3)

strategies.name: Short Put Butterfly
strategies.description: Short Put(K1) + 2*Put(K2) - Short Put(K3).
strategies.math: Max_Profit = C if S_T <= K1 or S_T >= K3
strategies.pseudocode: IF high_volatility: SELL(K1), BUY_2x(K2), SELL(K3)

strategies.name: Long Iron Butterfly
strategies.description: Long Put(K1) - Put(K2) - Call(K2) + Long Call(K3). Net credit.
strategies.pseudocode: IF neutral_low_vol: BUY(K1), SELL(K2), SELL(K2), BUY(K3)

strategies.name: Short Iron Butterfly
strategies.description: Short Put(K1) + Put(K2) + Call(K2) - Short Call(K3). Net debit.
strategies.math: Max_Profit = κ - D if S_T <= K1 or S_T >= K3
strategies.pseudocode: IF high_volatility: SELL(K1), BUY(K2), BUY(K2), SELL(K3)

strategies.name: Long Call Condor
strategies.description: Long Call(K1) - Call(K2) - Call(K3) + Long Call(K4). Wider butterfly.
strategies.math: Max_Profit = κ - D if K2 <= S_T <= K3
strategies.pseudocode: IF neutral_low_vol: BUY(K1), SELL(K2), SELL(K3), BUY(K4)

strategies.name: Long Put Condor
strategies.description: Long Put(K1) - Put(K2) - Put(K3) + Long Put(K4).
strategies.math: Max_Profit = κ - D if K2 <= S_T <= K3
strategies.pseudocode: IF neutral_low_vol: BUY(K1), SELL(K2), SELL(K3), BUY(K4)

strategies.name: Short Call Condor
strategies.description: Short Call(K1) + Call(K2) + Call(K3) - Short Call(K4).
strategies.math: Max_Profit = C if S_T <= K1 or S_T >= K4
strategies.pseudocode: IF high_volatility: SELL(K1), BUY(K2), BUY(K3), SELL(K4)

strategies.name: Short Put Condor
strategies.description: Short Put(K1) + Put(K2) + Put(K3) - Short Put(K4).
strategies.math: Max_Profit = C if S_T <= K1 or S_T >= K4
strategies.pseudocode: IF high_volatility: SELL(K1), BUY(K2), BUY(K3), SELL(K4)

strategies.name: Long Iron Condor
strategies.description: Long Put(K1) - Put(K2) - Call(K3) + Long Call(K4). Net credit.
strategies.math: Max_Profit = C if K2 <= S_T <= K3
strategies.pseudocode: IF neutral_low_vol: BUY(K1), SELL(K2), SELL(K3), BUY(K4)

strategies.name: Short Iron Condor
strategies.description: Short Put(K1) + Put(K2) + Call(K3) - Short Call(K4). Net debit.
strategies.math: Max_Profit = κ - D if S_T <= K1 or S_T >= K4
strategies.pseudocode: IF high_volatility: SELL(K1), BUY(K2), BUY(K3), SELL(K4)

strategies.name: Long Box
strategies.description: Long Put(K1) - Put(K2) + Long Call(K2) - Call(K1). Risk-free arb.
strategies.pseudocode: IF (K1 - K2) > Net_Debit: BUY_PUT(K1), SELL_PUT(K2), BUY_CALL(K2), SELL_CALL(K1)

strategies.name: Collar
strategies.description: Long Stock + Long Put(K1) - Call(K2). Zero-cost hedge.
strategies.math: Max_Profit = K2 - S_0; Max_Loss = S_0 - K1
strategies.pseudocode: IF holds_stock AND fear_of_crash: BUY_PUT(K1), SELL_CALL(K2)

strategies.name: Bullish Short Seagull
strategies.description: Short Put(K1) + Long Call(K2) - Call(K3). Zero-cost breakout.
strategies.pseudocode: IF bullish AND zero_cost: SELL_PUT(K1), BUY_CALL(K2), SELL_CALL(K3)

strategies.name: Price-Momentum (Cross-Sectional)
strategies.description: Long Top Decile, Short Bottom Decile by 12m-1m return.
strategies.pseudocode: RANK BY R_cum; BUY top_10%; SHORT bottom_10%

strategies.name: Earnings-Momentum
strategies.description: Long Top Decile by SUE (Standardized Unexpected Earnings).
strategies.pseudocode: CALCULATE SUE; RANK DESC; BUY top_10%; SHORT bottom_10%

strategies.name: Value
strategies.description: Long Top Decile by Book-to-Price (B/P), Short Bottom.
strategies.pseudocode: CALCULATE B/P; RANK DESC; BUY top_10%; SHORT bottom_10%

strategies.name: Low-Volatility Anomaly
strategies.description: Long Bottom Decile by Volatility, Short Top Decile.
strategies.pseudocode: CALCULATE 6m vol; RANK ASC; BUY bottom_10%; SHORT top_10%

strategies.name: Implied Volatility
strategies.description: Long stocks with rising Call IV, Short rising Put IV.
strategies.pseudocode: CALCULATE 1m IV change; RANK DESC; BUY top_10%; SHORT bottom_10%

strategies.name: Multifactor Portfolio
strategies.description: Combine Value, Momentum, Low-Vol into single portfolio.
strategies.pseudocode: AVERAGE ranks; BUY top_10%; SHORT bottom_10%

strategies.name: Residual Momentum
strategies.description: Momentum on residuals of Fama-French 3-factor regression.
strategies.pseudocode: REGRESS on MKT, SMB, HML; RANK residuals; BUY top_10%; SHORT bottom_10%

strategies.name: Pairs Trading (StatArb)
strategies.description: Long/Short cointegrated spread when Z-score > 2.0.
strategies.pseudocode: IF |Z| > 2.0: SHORT rich, BUY cheap. EXIT AT Z == 0

strategies.name: Mean-Reversion—Single Cluster
strategies.description: Short intra-sector leaders, buy laggards.
strategies.pseudocode: GROUP by industry; BUY negative R'_i, SHORT positive R'_i

strategies.name: Mean-Reversion—Multiple Clusters
strategies.description: Cluster MR across all sectors simultaneously.
strategies.pseudocode: REGRESS returns on industry matrix; BUY negative ϵ, SHORT positive ϵ

strategies.name: Mean-Reversion—Weighted Regression
strategies.description: Cluster MR weighted by inverse variance to reduce noise.
strategies.math: Weights z_i = 1 / σ_i^2; Minimize Σ z_i * ε_i^2
strategies.pseudocode: REGRESS with inverse variance weights; BUY negative ε, SHORT positive ε

strategies.name: Single Moving Average
strategies.description: Buy if P > SMA(T), Sell if P < SMA(T).
strategies.pseudocode: IF P(t) > SMA(T): BUY. IF P(t) < SMA(T): SELL

strategies.name: Two Moving Averages
strategies.description: Golden Cross / Death Cross (e.g., 50 SMA vs 200 SMA).
strategies.pseudocode: IF MA(50) > MA(200): BUY. IF MA(50) < MA(200): SELL

strategies.name: Three Moving Averages
strategies.description: Buy if MA(5) > MA(20) > MA(50).
strategies.pseudocode: IF MA(5) > MA(20) AND MA(20) > MA(50): BUY

strategies.name: Support and Resistance
strategies.description: Buy at Support, Sell at Resistance, or trade breakouts.
strategies.math: Pivot = (H + L + C) / 3; S1 = 2*P - H; R1 = 2*P - L
strategies.pseudocode: IF P <= S1 AND RSI < 30: BUY. IF P >= R1 AND Vol > Avg: BUY

strategies.name: Channel
strategies.description: Donchian/Bollinger Bands. Buy lower band, sell upper band.
strategies.math: Upper = Max(High, T); Lower = Min(Low, T)
strategies.pseudocode: IF P <= Lower: BUY. IF P >= Upper: SELL

strategies.name: Event-Driven—M&A
strategies.description: Buy Target, Short Acquirer (if stock deal) to capture spread.
strategies.pseudocode: IF deal_announced: BUY target. IF stock_deal: SHORT (ratio * acquirer)

strategies.name: Machine Learning—Single-Stock KNN
strategies.description: Predict next-day return using K-Nearest Neighbors on feature vector.
strategies.math: Y_pred = (1/K) * Σ Y(t'_k) for min Euclidean distance
strategies.pseudocode: COMPUTE X(t); FIND K nearest historical X; IF mean(Y) > threshold: BUY

strategies.name: Statistical Arbitrage—Optimization
strategies.description: Mean-variance optimization for dollar-neutral portfolio.
strategies.math: Maximize w^T * μ subject to w^T * 1 = 0
strategies.pseudocode: SOLVE for weights w that maximize Sharpe subject to sum(w) == 0

strategies.name: Market-Making
strategies.description: Quote bid/ask to capture spread, manage inventory risk.
strategies.math: Bid = m - s/2 - f(q); Ask = m + s/2 - f(q)
strategies.pseudocode: WHILE market_open: POST limit buy/sell adjusting for inventory q

strategies.name: Alpha Combos
strategies.description: Combine 100k+ faint ML alphas into mega-alpha portfolio.
strategies.pseudocode: CROSS-SECTIONALLY DEMEAN alphas; REGRESS forward returns; SET weights

strategies.name: Sector Momentum Rotation
strategies.description: Overweight outperforming sector ETFs, underweight laggards.
strategies.pseudocode: CALCULATE 12m return for ETFs; BUY top_10%; SHORT bottom_10%

strategies.name: Sector Momentum Rotation with MA Filter
strategies.description: Sector momentum + Price > 200-day SMA filter.
strategies.pseudocode: FILTER OUT ETFs where Price < 200-SMA; BUY top decile

strategies.name: Dual-Momentum Sector Rotation
strategies.description: Relative sector momentum + Absolute market trend filter.
strategies.math: IF P_SPY > SMA(200)_SPY: Top_Sector ELSE Treasury
strategies.pseudocode: IF S&P 500 > 200-SMA: BUY top sector ELSE MOVE to Bonds/Gold

strategies.name: Alpha Rotation
strategies.description: Rank ETFs by Jensen's Alpha (FF3 regression intercept).
strategies.pseudocode: REGRESS ETF returns on FF3; RANK BY alpha; BUY top_10%

strategies.name: R-squared
strategies.description: Overweight ETFs with high Alpha and low R-squared (high selectivity).
strategies.math: Selectivity = 1 - R^2; Signal = Rank(1 - R^2) AND Rank(alpha)
strategies.pseudocode: SORT into 5x5 matrix (R^2 vs Alpha); BUY (Low R^2, High Alpha)

strategies.name: Mean-reversion (ETF IBS)
strategies.description: Buy ETFs with IBS near 0, sell near 1. Overnight hold.
strategies.pseudocode: CALCULATE daily IBS; BUY bottom_10%; SHORT top_10%; EXIT next day open

strategies.name: Leveraged ETFs (LETFs)
strategies.description: Short 2x LETF + Short 2x Inverse LETF. Long Treasuries. Capture decay.
strategies.pseudocode: SHORT 2x Bull, SHORT 2x Bear; INVEST proceeds in T-Bills

strategies.name: Multi-asset Trend Following
strategies.description: Long global ETFs with positive momentum, weighted by inverse vol.
strategies.pseudocode: FILTER R^cum > 0 AND P > 200-SMA; ASSIGN weights; NORMALIZE to 1

strategies.name: Bullets
strategies.description: Portfolio of bonds all maturing at exact same target T.
strategies.pseudocode: IF outlook == 'rates_fall': SELECT T = 10-30y; BUY bonds maturing at T

strategies.name: Barbells
strategies.description: Short-term + Long-term bonds. Matches bullet duration, higher convexity.
strategies.pseudocode: SOLVE w1, w2 FOR Target_D; BUY w1 at T1, w2 at T2

strategies.name: Ladders
strategies.description: Equal capital in equidistant maturities. Roll down ladder.
strategies.pseudocode: FOR i = 1 to n: BUY Bond(Ti) weight 1/n; ROLL matured bonds

strategies.name: Bond Immunization
strategies.description: Match portfolio duration to liability horizon.
strategies.pseudocode: SELECT bonds such that Portfolio_Duration == Liability_Maturity

strategies.name: Dollar-Duration-Neutral Butterfly
strategies.description: Long T1, Short T2, Long T3. Neutral to parallel shifts.
strategies.pseudocode: SOLVE P1, P3 via P2 such that P1+P3=P2 AND DD_neutral

strategies.name: Fifty-Fifty Butterfly
strategies.description: Butterfly where P1*D1 = P3*D3. Symmetric wings.
strategies.pseudocode: SET P1*D1 = P3*D3; SOLVE for P2

strategies.name: Regression-Weighted Butterfly
strategies.description: Butterfly weighted by historical regression beta of spread changes.
strategies.pseudocode: RUN regression of 2s5s on 5s10s to get β; SET P1*D1 = β * P3*D3

strategies.name: Maturity-Weighted Butterfly
strategies.description: Butterfly where β is derived deterministically from maturities.
strategies.pseudocode: CALCULATE β based on T1, T2, T3; SET P1*D1 = β * P3*D3

strategies.name: Low-Risk Factor
strategies.description: Long bottom decile by maturity within high-quality credit.
strategies.pseudocode: FILTER by IG; RANK BY Maturity ASC; BUY bottom_10%

strategies.name: Value Factor
strategies.description: Long bonds cheap relative to theoretical spread from rating/maturity.
strategies.pseudocode: REGRESS Spread on Rating/Maturity; BUY top_10% by V

strategies.name: Carry Factor
strategies.description: Long top decile by carry (yield + roll-down return).
strategies.pseudocode: CALCULATE Carry; RANK DESC; BUY top_10%

strategies.name: Rolling Down the Yield Curve
strategies.description: Buy bonds in steepest part of curve, hold as they age.
strategies.pseudocode: BUY bonds in steepest segment; HOLD as they approach maturity

strategies.name: Yield Curve Spread
strategies.description: Flattener (Short Front, Long Back) or Steepener.
strategies.pseudocode: IF rates_rise: SELL short-m, BUY long-m (Flattener)

strategies.name: CDS Basis Arbitrage
strategies.description: Long Bond + Long CDS if Basis < 0.
strategies.pseudocode: IF Basis < -Threshold: BUY Cash_Bond, BUY CDS_Protection

strategies.name: Swap-Spread Arbitrage
strategies.description: Long Swap + Short Treasury (or vice versa).
strategies.pseudocode: IF Swap_Spread too wide: RECEIVE Fixed Swap, SHORT Treasury

strategies.name: Cash-and-carry Arbitrage (Indexes)
strategies.description: Long Spot Basket + Short Index Futures.
strategies.pseudocode: IF F > F_fair + costs: SHORT futures, BUY spot basket

strategies.name: Dispersion Trading in Equity Indexes
strategies.description: Short Index Straddle + Long Single-Stock Straddles.
strategies.math: σ_I = sqrt( Σ w_i * w_j * σ_i * σ_j * ρ_ij )
strategies.pseudocode: IF Index_IV > Theoretical: SELL index_straddle, BUY constituent_straddles

strategies.name: Dispersion Trading: Subset Portfolio
strategies.description: Dispersion using PCA to filter noise and trade top N* stocks.
strategies.math: Select top N* stocks with lowest specific risk ξ_i^2
strategies.pseudocode: COMPUTE PCA; SELECT top N* stocks; SELL index, BUY subset

strategies.name: Intraday Arbitrage Between Index ETFs
strategies.description: Exploit ephemeral mispricings between SPY and IVV.
strategies.pseudocode: IF P1_Bid > P2_Ask * κ: SELL ETF1, BUY ETF2 simultaneously

strategies.name: Index Volatility Targeting
strategies.description: Dynamic allocation between Index and T-Bills to target constant vol.
strategies.pseudocode: SET Index_Weight = σ_target / σ(t); REBALANCE weekly/monthly

strategies.name: VIX Futures Basis Trading
strategies.description: Short VIX Futures in Contango to capture roll yield.
strategies.pseudocode: IF B_VIX > 0: SHORT UX1. Hedge with mini-SPX

strategies.name: Volatility Carry with Two ETNs
strategies.description: Short VXX + Long (h * VXZ). Capture differential decay.
strategies.pseudocode: SHORT 1 unit VXX; LONG h units VXZ; REBALANCE monthly

strategies.name: Volatility Risk Premium
strategies.description: Short ATM Straddle on SPX when VIX > RV.
strategies.pseudocode: IF VIX > 21-day RV: SELL ATM_STRADDLE

strategies.name: Volatility Risk Premium with Gamma Hedging
strategies.description: Short Straddle + Dynamic Delta Hedge (Gamma Scalping).
strategies.pseudocode: SELL ATM_STRADDLE; IF Delta != 0: BUY/SELL underlying to reset

strategies.name: Volatility Skew—Long Risk Reversal
strategies.description: Long OTM Call + Short OTM Put. Zero-cost skew trade.
strategies.pseudocode: IF Put_Skew historically high: BUY OTM_CALL, SELL OTM_PUT

strategies.name: Volatility Trading with Variance Swaps
strategies.description: Long/Short Variance Swap for pure vol exposure.
strategies.pseudocode: IF IV < Forecasted_RV: BUY Variance Swap

strategies.name: FX Moving Averages with HP Filter
strategies.description: Dual MA crossover on Hodrick-Prescott filtered FX rate.
strategies.pseudocode: APPLY HP Filter; CALCULATE MA(10) and MA(50); BUY if MA10 > MA50

strategies.name: FX Carry Trade
strategies.description: Short Low-Yield Currency + Long High-Yield Currency.
strategies.pseudocode: BORROW low-yield, BUY high-yield; HOLD unhedged

strategies.name: FX High-minus-low Carry
strategies.description: Long Top Quantile by Forward Discount, Short Bottom.
strategies.pseudocode: CALCULATE 1m forward discount; RANK DESC; BUY top_33%; SELL bottom_33%

strategies.name: FX Dollar Carry Trade
strategies.description: Long/Short basket of FX vs USD based on avg forward discount.
strategies.math: D_avg = (1/N) * Σ D_i; IF D_avg > 0: Long FX / Short USD
strategies.pseudocode: AVERAGE forward discounts vs USD; IF > 0: BUY basket, SELL USD

strategies.name: FX Momentum and Carry Combo
strategies.description: Min-variance weighted portfolio of FX Momentum and Carry.
strategies.pseudocode: COMPUTE covariance of Carry & Mom; SOLVE min-var weights; COMBINE

strategies.name: FX Triangular Arbitrage
strategies.description: Circular chain of 3 currency pairs to lock risk-free profit.
strategies.pseudocode: IF (Bid(A->B) * Bid(B->C) * Bid(C->A)) > 1.0005: EXECUTE loop

strategies.name: Commodities - Roll Yields
strategies.description: Long Backwardated, Short Contango commodities.
strategies.pseudocode: RANK commodities BY phi; BUY highest, SELL lowest

strategies.name: Commodities - Hedging Pressure
strategies.description: Trade divergence in COT Hedging Pressure (Hedgers vs Speculators).
strategies.pseudocode: CALCULATE HP from COT; BUY lower Speculator HP if Hedger HP is bottom quintile

strategies.name: Commodities - Portfolio Diversification
strategies.description: Fixed % allocation to broad commodity index for low correlation.
strategies.pseudocode: SOLVE weights to maximize portfolio Sharpe ratio; REBALANCE quarterly

strategies.name: Commodities - Value
strategies.description: Long commodities with high P_5yr / P_0 ratio.
strategies.pseudocode: CALCULATE 5-year price ratio; RANK DESC; BUY top_33%

strategies.name: Commodities - Skewness Premium
strategies.description: Long bottom quintile by historical skewness, short top.
strategies.pseudocode: CALCULATE historical skewness; RANK ASC; BUY bottom_20%; SELL top_20%

strategies.name: Commodities - Trading with Pricing Models
strategies.description: Trade residuals between OU model futures price and market price.
strategies.math: dX(t) = kappa * (a - X(t)) * dt + sigma * dW(t)
strategies.pseudocode: FIT OU model; IF F_market > F_model + threshold: SELL futures

strategies.name: Futures - Hedging Risk with Futures
strategies.description: Short hedge (Long Spot + Short Futures) or Long hedge.
strategies.pseudocode: IF exposure == 'long_physical': SELL futures equal to exposure

strategies.name: Futures - Cross-Hedging
strategies.description: Hedge asset A using highly correlated futures B.
strategies.pseudocode: RUN regression of Spot on Futures; SELL beta * exposure futures

strategies.name: Futures - Interest Rate Risk Hedging
strategies.description: Hedge bond portfolio duration with Treasury futures.
strategies.pseudocode: CALCULATE BPV; N = BPV_portfolio / (BPV_futures * CF); SELL N futures

strategies.name: Futures - Calendar Spreads
strategies.description: Trade spread between near and deferred month futures.
strategies.pseudocode: IF S < Historical_Mean - 2*StdDev: BUY P_1, SELL P_2

strategies.name: Futures - Inter-Commodity Spreads (Crack Spread)
strategies.description: 3-2-1 Crack Spread: Long 3 Crude, Short 2 Gas, Short 1 Heat.
strategies.pseudocode: CALCULATE 3-2-1 Crack; IF Z-score < -2: BUY products, SELL crude

strategies.name: Futures - Trend Following (TSMOM)
strategies.description: Long/Short global futures based on 12m time-series momentum.
strategies.pseudocode: FOR each future: IF 12m return > 0: LONG; ELSE SHORT; SIZE to 10% vol

strategies.name: Futures - Mean Reversion (Short-Term)
strategies.description: Contrarian positions based on 1-week to 1-month returns.
strategies.pseudocode: CALCULATE 1-week return; RANK ASC; BUY bottom 20%, SELL top 20%

strategies.name: Structured Assets - CDO Tranche Trading
strategies.description: Trade implied correlation skew between CDX tranches.
strategies.math: Tranche_Loss = max(0, min(Portfolio_Loss - Attachment, Detachment - Attachment))
strategies.pseudocode: IF corr skew wide: SELL Equity protection, BUY Mezzanine protection

strategies.name: Structured Assets - MBS OAS Trading
strategies.description: Long MBS + Short Treasury Futures (Duration Hedged).
strategies.pseudocode: IF OAS > Historical_Mean + 1*StdDev: BUY MBS; SELL Treasury futures

strategies.name: Distressed Debt - Passive Diversified
strategies.description: Equal-weight portfolio of bonds trading < $50 or YTM > 15%.
strategies.pseudocode: FILTER bonds Price < $50; BUY equal-weight basket of top 50

strategies.name: Distressed Debt - Capital Structure Arbitrage
strategies.description: Long Senior Debt + Short Common Equity of distressed firm.
strategies.pseudocode: IF Bond_EV > Stock_EV: BUY Senior Bonds, SHORT Stock

strategies.name: Real Assets - REITs (Momentum & Value)
strategies.description: Long REITs with high FFO yield and strong 6m momentum.
strategies.pseudocode: CALCULATE FFO Yield and 6m return; COMBINE ranks; BUY top 20%

strategies.name: Cryptocurrencies - Trend Following
strategies.description: Long BTC/ETH when Price > 200-day MA; Stablecoins when <.
strategies.pseudocode: IF Price > 200-SMA: BUY and HOLD; IF < : SELL and HOLD Stablecoins

strategies.name: Municipal Bond Tax Arbitrage
strategies.description: Short Cash (Loan) + Long Tax-Exempt Muni Bond.
strategies.pseudocode: IF r_muni > r_loan * (1 - τ): BORROW cash, BUY muni

strategies.name: Cross-Border Tax Arbitrage
strategies.description: Short stock cum-dividend + Long stock ex-dividend (or swap).
strategies.pseudocode: IF foreign_investor AND imputation_system: SELL cum-div, BUY ex-div

strategies.name: Inflation Hedging—Inflation Swaps
strategies.description: Long Inflation Swap (Receive floating CPI, Pay fixed).
strategies.pseudocode: IF inflation_expectation > breakeven: BUY inflation_swap

strategies.name: TIPS-Treasury Arbitrage
strategies.description: Short Treasury + Long TIPS + Long Inflation Swaps + Long STRIPS.
strategies.pseudocode: IF P_Treasury > P_rep + Costs: SHORT Treasury, BUY replicating portfolio

strategies.name: Weather Risk—Demand Hedging
strategies.description: Long HDD / Short CDD futures to hedge weather demand risk.
strategies.math: CDD = Max(T_avg - T_base, 0); HDD = Max(T_base - T_avg, 0)
strategies.pseudocode: IF negative correlation with CDD: BUY CDD puts or SHORT CDD futures

strategies.name: Energy—Spark Spread
strategies.description: Long Electricity + Short Natural Gas (scaled by Heat Rate).
strategies.pseudocode: IF expected_spark > operating_costs: BUY elec, SELL gas (adjusted by HR)

strategies.name: Buying and Holding Distressed Debt
strategies.description: Long diversified basket of bonds with >1000 bps spread.
strategies.pseudocode: FILTER bonds spread > 1000 bps; BUY equally-weighted portfolio of 50+

strategies.name: Active Distressed Investing
strategies.description: Long distressed debt to acquire control via 'loan-to-own'.
strategies.math: Strategy: Acquire debt > X% to gain voting rights
strategies.pseudocode: ACCUMULATE senior secured debt; PROPOSE reorganization plan for equity

strategies.name: Distress Risk Puzzle
strategies.description: Long low bankruptcy probability stocks, short high probability.
strategies.pseudocode: CALCULATE bankruptcy prob; RANK ASC; BUY bottom_10%; SHORT top_10%

strategies.name: Mixed-Asset Diversification with Real Estate
strategies.description: Traditional stock/bond portfolio + 5-15% Real Estate.
strategies.math: Maximize Sharpe Ratio subject to w_stock + w_bond + w_re = 1
strategies.pseudocode: CALCULATE covariance matrix; OPTIMIZE weights; REBALANCE quarterly

strategies.name: Real Estate Momentum—Regional Approach
strategies.description: Long top decile of MSAs by past return, short bottom.
strategies.math: R_i_cum = Return of MSA_i over past T months
strategies.pseudocode: CALCULATE 12m return for regional indices; RANK DESC; BUY top_10%

strategies.name: Cross-Border Tax Arbitrage with Options
strategies.description: Sell stock cum-dividend + Write deep ITM put to capture tax credit.
strategies.pseudocode: IF foreign_investor: SELL stock cum-div; WRITE deep ITM put
